items.headline: Burch hits 200 yards again and Buffalo wins 6th straight, 40-21 over Central Michigan
items.description: — Messiah Burch ran for 200 yards and scored twice for the second consecutive game and Buffalo won its sixth-straight game 40-21 over Central Michigan on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Burch becomes 12th Buffalo player with 1,000 rushing yards in 28-7 win over Ball State
items.description: — Messiah Burch ran for a career-high 209 yards and two touchdowns and Buffalo defeated Ball State 28-7 on Wednesday night for their fifth straight victory.
